calibration.caveat: Fixed training prefix, dense-history calibration; quantiles are not guaranteed update budgets under accumulated sparse history.
calibration.descriptor: Tile RMS evidence difference / max current/reference RMS; all evidence channels; no GT or current full-update output

caveats: Fixed-weight sparse inference intervention; not a trained sparse model or convergence result.
Evidence encoder/context and readout/head remain dense. Reference+age increase cache and warp costs.
Same GPU paired sequential model time excludes IO/voxelization/postprocess; other GPU training may influence host load.
Do not select gate thresholds on validation AP or report prefix AP as full-set AP.

dense_after.timing_scope: Synchronized model, including FM/warp/gate/cache/crops/decoder/head; excludes IO, voxelization, postprocess; instrumentation included
